description: This file is a shell script used for testing the multi-pack bitmap functionality in a Git repository. It contains functions for setting up test repositories, performing various operations related to bitmap and multi-pack index management, and verifying the correctness and resilience of bitmap handling in different scenarios.

methods.name: bitmap_reuse_tests
methods.description: Sets up and tests bitmap reuse scenarios between different pack types.

methods.name: test_midx_bitmap_cases
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive suite of tests for multi-pack index bitmap functionality with different configurations.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Corrupts a given file by modifying its checksum to simulate invalid bitmap files for testing fsck.
